| assets/vendor/globe.gl.min.js | 2.46.2 | MIT | https://github.com/vasturiano/globe.gl |
| assets/vendor/topojson-client.min.js | 3.1.0 | ISC | https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client |
| assets/geo/countries-110m.json | world-atlas 2.0.2 | ISC (원자료 Natural Earth, 퍼블릭 도메인) | https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas |
